title: Georgetown Taiwanese American Student Association
content_html:
The Georgetown Taiwanese American Student Association (TASA) is a student organization at Georgetown University in Washington, D.C., dedicated to promoting Taiwanese culture through social, educational, and cultural programming. The organization is officially recognized by the university and is listed in Georgetown’s student organization directory, where it is reachable at tasa@georgetown.edu. It is also a named member of the Students of Color Alliance (SOCA), Georgetown’s umbrella coalition of cultural student organizations.

TASA has participated in Mid-Atlantic regional events and ITASA national conferences, and has historically served as a resource and support network for both Taiwanese American students and students from Taiwan interested in Taiwanese culture. The organization maintains active social media presences on Instagram (@georgetowntasa) and Facebook (georgetowntasa). Georgetown University has also highlighted TASA as one of the student groups that recognizes AAPI heritage with events across campus year-round.
